caption:
She cut through dragon fire with lightning.
Seedance 2.5 built this whole sky battle.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 20 seconds. Aspect ratio 16:9. Look: premium cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime (high-end game-cinematic quality), bold saturated colors, crisp ink outlines, hard-edged shadows, highly detailed armor and scales, volumetric clouds, heavy debris and dust physics, subtle film grain. Color scheme: electric blue lightning versus molten orange fire and a golden sunset. Lens: wide 24mm for action, 85mm for close-ups. Camera feel: fast, aggressive, sweeping action camera with tracking, whip moves and big crane reveals; quick cuts in the battle, then a slow, calm ending. Pacing: frantic for 13 seconds, then quiet and epic.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WARRIOR: young woman, early 20s, slim and athletic, pale skin, short spiky silver-white hair with longer front strands, sharp anime face, glowing ice-blue eyes. Long crimson scarf-cape around her neck and shoulders, its tails always whipping in the wind. Black armored bodice with gold trim and a gold emblem, black-and-gold gauntlets over fingerless black gloves, layered black-and-red battle skirt, black thigh-high boots with white straps. Weapon: a broken spear (dark shaft, gold bands, a jagged short steel head).
- THE DRAGON: colossal four-legged armored dragon, the size of a fortress tower. Obsidian-black plated armor scales with glowing molten-orange cracks all over, rows of jagged spikes along the neck and back, curved black horns, glowing orange eyes with slit pupils, a ribbed golden-orange belly, enormous dark-red bat-like wings.

LOCATION: an ancient floating sky fortress of grey stone (wide flat platforms, square stone pillars, crenellated walls, a central square tower) high above an endless sea of golden clouds and a distant ocean at sunset. Low sun on the horizon, storm-grey clouds above.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.8) — Claw smash. Low-angle close-up at ground level: the dragon's giant black clawed forefoot slams onto a stone platform, cracks glowing orange, rubble and dust bursting out. Fast pull-back to a low wide shot: the dragon's head and forearm fill the frame; the tiny warrior, red scarf flying, is on its forearm and stabs the broken spear into a glowing orange crack. MUST SHOW: a burst of blue sparks where the spear hits.
SHOT 2 (00:01.8-00:02.9) — Thrown. Wide shot against the sunset sky: the dragon snaps its wrist off-screen and the warrior is hurled through the air past two square stone pillars; one pillar shatters, a big stone block tumbles; she flies over the fortress edge and drops out of frame.
SHOT 3 (00:02.9-00:04.3) — Awakening. Medium close-up, camera falling with her, storm-grey clouds rushing upward behind her: she falls facing the lens, arms spread, scarf billowing above, eyes glowing blue. She grips the broken spear in both hands; blue lightning crackles around her arms and the spear. MUST SHOW: the spear transforms into a long glowing electric-blue blade wrapped in jagged arcs of lightning.
SHOT 4 (00:04.3-00:04.8) — Rebound. Wide side view midair: she flies horizontally with the glowing blue blade forward and kicks off a large falling rock fragment, launching back upward.
SHOT 5 (00:04.8-00:06.0) — The charge. Wide shot: the dragon stands on a crenellated stone wall, wings fully spread, horns up, against the stormy sunset. The warrior streaks toward it from the left leaving a jagged blue lightning trail, then dives at it blade raised overhead.
SHOT 6 (00:06.0-00:07.0) — Through the fire. Wide side shot: the dragon unleashes a colossal torrent of orange-yellow fire that fills the frame; the warrior cuts straight through it with the blue blade, the fire splitting around her.
SHOT 7 (00:07.0-00:07.6) — Impact. Medium-wide: the fire stream explodes against the stone wall, rocks and flames flying; the warrior lands on the wall in a crouch, the blade glowing blue.
SHOT 8 (00:07.6-00:09.3) — The run. Tracking shot along the dragon's side, dust and falling debris everywhere: the warrior sprints up its dark-red wing and spiked back toward its neck, blade trailing blue light; thin blue lightning veins spread across the black armor. Camera rises to a side view of her on top of the dragon's neck.
SHOT 9 (00:09.3-00:10.8) — Lightning sword. Wide rear shot, symmetrical: the warrior stands on the dragon's spiked neck between its two raised wing tips, seen from behind, the low sun glowing on the horizon straight ahead over golden clouds. She raises the blade overhead and it erupts into a gigantic column of blue lightning shooting into the sky. MUST SHOW: the towering spectral lightning blade, many times her height, with forked branches. Scarf whips sideways.
SHOT 10 (00:10.8-00:11.9) — The eyes. Extreme close-up of the dragon's face filling the frame: two huge orange slit-pupil eyes widen; the molten-orange cracks across its black scales turn electric blue, starting from the edges. Locked-off with a slight push-in.
SHOT 11 (00:11.9-00:12.5) — The slash. Same wide rear shot as SHOT 9: the giant blue blade comes down in one colossal slash; a blinding white flash fills the frame.
SHOT 12 (00:12.5-00:13.3) — Shatter. Low angle from behind the warrior: the dragon's armor explodes into hundreds of glowing orange-black fragments flying past the lens; blue lightning crackles around her legs.
SHOT 13 (00:13.3-00:17.6) — Aftermath. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind her right side, she stands on the last stone platform above the sea of clouds: far away the dragon has crashed into the ocean, and a gigantic golden wave and spray column rises against the sunset, then slowly sinks. Her blade still glows blue, then the lightning fades and it returns to the broken spear, held low at her side. She lifts her gloved forearm and wipes soot from her cheek. Scarf tails whip in the wind; the sun flares warm gold. Slow gentle drift.
SHOT 14 (00:17.6-00:19.6) — Final view. Extreme wide aerial shot: the ruined floating fortress hangs above the clouds, waterfalls pouring off its edges into the mist, small floating rock islands and fragments around it, the sun on the horizon. The tiny warrior stands alone on top of the central tower. MUST SHOW: one final thin blue lightning bolt flashes down from the sky above the fortress. Very slow push-in.
SHOT 15 (00:19.6-00:20.1) — Cut to black.

SOUND: no dialogue, no narration. Epic orchestral instrumental score with heavy taiko drums and choir building through the fight, cutting to near-silence on the white flash, then a soft, warm string resolve for the aftermath and final view. SFX: a thunderous claw slam and cracking stone (SHOT 1); a sharp metal clang and sparks; whooshing wind and shattering pillar (SHOT 2); crackling, rising electric hum (SHOT 3); a deep roar and the roaring rush of fire (SHOT 6); explosion and falling rocks (SHOT 7); pounding footsteps on scales (SHOT 8); a booming thunderclap as the lightning blade rises (SHOT 9); a low rumbling growl (SHOT 10); a massive thunder crack and a deep boom (SHOT 11); shattering armor and debris (SHOT 12); a distant huge splash and wind (SHOT 13); waterfalls and one faint final thunder roll (SHOT 14).
prompt_short: Cel-shaded 3D anime, 16:9, golden sunset sky fortress. Silver-haired warrior in a red scarf turns her broken spear into a lightning blade, slices through dragon fire, raises a giant lightning sword and fells an obsidian dragon into the sea. Epic.
